sqli.name: Single Quote Error Probe
sqli.description: Tests if unescaped single quotes produce database syntax errors or unhandled 500 exceptions during SQL query execution.
sqli.recommendation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for all database operations.

sqli.name: Double Quote Error Probe
sqli.description: Tests if unescaped double quotes produce database syntax errors during SQL query execution.
sqli.recommendation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for all database operations.

sqli.name: Boolean-Based Differential SQLi (Numeric)
sqli.description: Tests if numeric TRUE condition (1 AND 1=1) yields baseline response while FALSE condition (1 AND 1=2) causes response divergence (different status, length, or content).
sqli.recommendation: Ensure user input is strictly parameterized with prepared statements.

sqli.name: Boolean-Based Differential SQLi (String/Quote)
sqli.description: Tests if string-quoted TRUE condition (' AND '1'='1) matches baseline while FALSE condition (' AND '1'='2) alters response state.
sqli.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with strict parameter binding.

sqli.name: Boolean-Based Tautology SQLi
sqli.description: Tests if logical OR tautology expands query results while false condition restricts or alters output.
sqli.recommendation: Ensure user input is strictly parameterized rather than interpolated into SQL statements.

sqli.name: SQL Authentication Bypass Probe
sqli.description: Tests if authentication logic can be bypassed by terminating SQL WHERE conditions.
sqli.recommendation: Use prepared statements with strict parameter binding.

sqli.name: Time-Based Blind Delay Probe
sqli.description: Tests if server response time is delayed by database sleep/delay functions, indicating time-based blind SQLi.
sqli.recommendation: Never concatenate user input into database queries. Use parameterized queries with strict ORM mapping.

xss.name: Reflected HTML Canary Tag Probe
xss.description: Checks if unescaped HTML tags are reflected verbatim into the response body.
xss.recommendation: Apply context-sensitive HTML entity encoding before rendering untrusted input in HTML documents.

xss.name: HTML Attribute Breakout Canary
xss.description: Tests if double quotes escape HTML attribute contexts unencoded.
xss.recommendation: Escape attribute values and implement a strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP).

command_injection.name: Safe Shell Echo Canary (Semicolon)
command_injection.description: Checks if OS command chaining operator (;) executes secondary shell commands.
command_injection.recommendation: Avoid using shell execution functions. Use execFile with predefined argument arrays and strict regex validation.

command_injection.name: Safe Shell Echo Canary (Pipe)
command_injection.description: Checks if pipe operator (|) executes secondary shell commands.
command_injection.recommendation: Avoid using shell execution functions. Use execFile with predefined argument arrays and strict regex validation.

ssti.name: Server-Side Template Math Probe (Double Curly)
ssti.description: Tests if template expressions like {{77*77}} are dynamically computed into 5929 by the server-side template engine.
ssti.recommendation: Do not pass user-supplied input directly into template compilation functions; use static templates with parameter binding.

ssti.name: Server-Side Template Math Probe (Dollar Curly)
ssti.description: Tests if template expressions like ${77*77} are dynamically computed into 5929 by the server-side template engine.
ssti.recommendation: Do not pass user-supplied input directly into template compilation functions; use static templates with parameter binding.
